name: Invokely statistics API
description: Official statistics with unit, period, normalized place and citable source. Same operations and metering as the MCP server at /mcp. The data endpoints need an API key on the Builder or Pro plan, or prepaid credits; Free keys get 402 PLAN_REQUIRED and can use the MCP server instead. CSV export and the catalog endpoints work on every plan.
